title: ThirdPartyComponentAssessment
description: DERIVED from distilled/messages.yaml (§5.1.2, §5.2.3); the EN defines no schema and no encoding. AI security risk assessment and due diligence for external components, providers and released models.

component_ref.description: the external component, provider or released model assessed

ai_security_risk_assessment.description: AI security risk assessment of the external component
ai_security_risk_assessment.x-condition: where an external component is used

due_diligence.description: due diligence in line with existing software development processes, assessing AI-specific risks
due_diligence.x-condition: where an external component is used

external_provider_due_diligence.description: due diligence assessment of the external provider
external_provider_due_diligence.x-condition: where the Developer or System Operator chooses to work with an external provider

provider_adherence.description: the provider is adhering to the present document

re_run_evaluations.description: evaluations re-run on released models intended for use
re_run_evaluations.x-condition: for released models the organization intends to use
